evidence: Carries the P2P label and replaces the P2P networking and connection management code for private transaction broadcast.
rationale: Architectural isolation resolves critical privacy leaks and node crash hazards during transaction relay. The PR description notes that isolating broadcast jobs protects 'against IP address linkage and not crashing the node on adversarial inputs (which is a leak in itself)' while stripping coupled state out of CConnman and PeerManager.
